title: World trade
subtitle: UN Comtrade merchandise trade, reporter-to-world and India bilateral
_keys: The key space this dataset is indexed by. A join with another dataset is only offered where the two share a key, or where a concordance bridges them. Declaring this is what lets the shell know what can meet what.
_periodBasis: Calendar year and calendar month. See config/scope.json -> periods.

surface._route: The dataset's own page. Comtrade is the incumbent, so its route is the dashboard root rather than a sub-page.
surface._panels: Panels this dataset contributes to pages owned by others, matched on key. Comtrade contributes nothing outward yet; other datasets contribute inward to its product pages.
